title: Health Sector Strategic Plan III 2023-2030
publisher: Government of the Republic of Malawi
why_not: A plan: it states what the HMIS will be at each level, not which tiers use it or where reports are keyed; its one dated fact (mobile DHIS2 in 15 districts, over 2,000 tablets, under HSSP II) predates the gap window and is stated by leads 1 and 2; no HMIS finance figure.
